requirements.question: What do governments and international bodies say, decide and vote on about conflicts, deployments and crises, and does what they say match what the suite's sensors see?
What are the Russian, UK and EU governments saying in their own official statements, which countries do they name, and do they claim de-escalation, deny an act, give an assurance, threaten or accuse?
Which resolutions has the UN Security Council adopted or failed to adopt, on which countries, unanimously or not, and was a veto cast?
Which communiqués and press statements has the African Union Peace and Security Council issued, and on which countries?
When a statement claims calm (de-escalation, denial, assurance), did other TIC programs publish anomalies or warnings in the same countries within 72 hours?
